description: Get historical MeteoSwiss OGD measurements for one station and date range by parsing the STAC CSV assets. Daily data defaults to the smaller recent/historical files. Hourly history is limited to 14 days because decade files are large. Times are Swiss local time (no offset).

collection.description: OGD collection alias (default smn). Aliases: smn, smn-precip, smn-tower, nime, nbcn, nbcn-precip, obs, phenology, tot. A full STAC id such as ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn is also accepted.

granularity.description: Resolution: t, h, d (daily, default), m, or y.

limit.description: Maximum rows (default 31, max 100). When truncated, the latest rows in the range are kept.

parameters.description: Comma-separated parameter codes, or omit for the common meteorological columns.

name: get_ogd_history
